scorecard.venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: TM Head
batting.dismissal: c B Sai Sudharsan b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b M Prasidh Krishna

batting.name: Nithish Kumar Reddy
batting.dismissal: c Rashid Khan b R Sai Kishore

batting.name: PHKD Mendis
batting.dismissal: c B Sai Sudharsan b M Prasidh Krishna

batting.name: B Sai Sudharsan
batting.dismissal: c Aniket Verma b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c H Klaasen b PJ Cummins

batting.name: Washington Sundar
batting.dismissal: c Aniket Verma b Mohammed Shami

balls.text: into the blockhole on middle and off. Shami digs it out towards long off and then has to hustle back as Cummins insists on the second. Labours a little but manages to get home. SRH finish with 152!

short, wide and Shami wants a piece of his long-time India teammate too! Not great bowling it must be said, but these are valuable, valuable runs. Shami throws the kitchen sink at it and flays it over extra cover!
low full toss on the pads. Cummins snaps his wrists into action and tugs it towards deep backward point, while almost losing his balance. Hit too firmly to even contemplate the second

banged into the track wide outside off and this seems to balloon over the batter's head. Cummins lets it go but the umpires do not call it a wide. Cummins throws his head back in disappointment, and SRH cannot review either

right out of the screws! Captain Fantastic is giving SRH fans something to cheer about! Back of a length outside off and this just sits up for Cummins. He gives it all he has and whacks it clean over deep mid wicket!
Cummins starts the 20th with a boundary! Wide yorker that goes wrong and ends up as a low full toss. Cummins sits deep in his crease and blazes it past extra cover!

leg stump flat on the ground, and Siraj has four! Slanted in on a length, pitching on off and continuing on with the angle. Simarjeet has a wild slog across the line and only swats away a few flies. Siraj celebrates like Cristiano Ronaldo almost always does, and this has been another incredibly impactful performance!
another sizzling yorker outside off. Simarjeet is late in getting his bat down and the ball breezes past the toe-end of his blade

Siraj appeals, and the finger goes up instantly! Searing in-swinging yorker on middle and leg. Aniket opens up his stance and tries to flick it away. Misses it completely and gets smashed on the back leg. Looked pretty adjacent but Aniket has reviewed because, well, why not. No bat involved, and that has rapped Aniket right in front of the stumps. Aniket, in fact, starts walking towards the dressing room after seeing the first replay. Ball Tracking comes up and it shows the ball to be thundering into leg stump! Aniket has to go, and SRH are now seven down!

slow, short and wide outside off. Aniket swishes himself off his feet but still cannot make contact. SRH batters look at the umpire and then go upstairs. There is a chunk of the ball inside the revised guideline, and the non-wide call stays!
into the blockhole on leg stump. Aniket jams down on it and digs it out towards deep mid wicket
shortish on middle and off. Cummins gives himself room and swats it towards long on
slower bumper outside off. Cummins swings at it with all his might and toe-ends it towards long on
thumped down the ground! Banged into the track outside off. Cummins picks the slower one early, stands up tall and slaps it over mid off!
back of a length just outside off. Punched down the ground to long on
slower ball bowled short outside off again. Cummins hangs back and jabs it towards deep point, via backward point's right hand
oh wow - what a way to get off the mark! Shortish outside off and Cummins pounces on the width. Peels the outer cover off the ball and scythes it past backward point. That flew off the bat!
back of a length outside off. Aniket lets the ball come to him before guiding it down to deep third

high into the night sky, and nestling into another Titan's palms! Off-pace and into the track on middle and leg. Kamindu looks to swipe it over deep square leg but does not get the power he wants. Goes as far as Sudharsan on the deep backward square leg fence and he makes absolutely no mistake. The one step forward, one step back theme continues for SRH!
back of a length outside off. Aniket smartly drops it into the off side and picks up a single

streaky but SRH will grab that with both hands! Back of a length in the channel. Aniket goes feeling for it and the ball skews off the outside edge. Fine enough to beat short third and wide enough to make Buttler redundant!
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Aniket uses the angle and helps it round the corner. Enough to deep square leg's right and he canters back for two
hold that pose, Aniket Verma! Half-volley outside off and Aniket climbs into it. Gets his hands through the ball and blasts it between extra cover and mid off!
shortish on the hips. Kamindu looks to help it fine but does not get bat on it. Flicks the thigh pad and rolls towards fine leg
back of a length outside off. Kamindu waits for it and punches it towards long on
carrom ball on a back of a length outside off. Kamindu plays for the ball coming in and is bamboozled as it sneaks past the outside edge by spinning away
back of a length just outside off. Aniket gets onto the back foot and knocks it towards long on
slower and fuller just outside off. Aniket gets onto the front foot and defends with soft hands

celebrappeal by Sai Kishore, but the umpire does not move a muscle! Fizzed in on a length just outside off and this spins back sharply into Kamindu. He plays all around it and gets pinged on the back leg. Impact seemed to be outside the line and GT do not review after deliberation

Nitish Kumar Reddy perishes too, and the momentum and the energy has been sucked out of SRH's innings and their fans again! Floated up nicely on a full length just outside leg. Reddy tries to smash it over cow corner but the ball is perhaps too full. Might have held up a shade too and he cloths it off the bottom part of the bat. Rashid is stationed on the deep mid wicket fence and he makes no mistake. Reddy walks off frustrated; Sai Kishore mobbed by his teammates for another crafty piece of bowling!
back of a length on middle and leg. Aniket shuffles across, tries to work to leg but is late on the stroke. Gets pinged on the thigh pad
dug into the track just outside off. Reddy is hustled on the pull and flat-bats it towards long on
full just outside off. Reddy jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Reddy hangs back and taps it tamely towards backward point
back of a length just outside off. Reddy nudges it to the edge of the ring in the mid on region and scampers back for two
back of a length on middle and off. Aniket drops it into the off side and calls his partner through for the single
tossed up full outside off. Aniket gets a big stride in and pushes it towards long off

Sai Kishore bursts through Klaasen's defences, and he sets off in celebration! And Hyderabad has been stunned! Back of a length, angling into middle and leg. Klaasen looks for that straight-bat pull that is his trademark but this ball just keeps coming back into him. Rushes him a little too and sneaks past his bat before knocking back the top of leg stump. Sai Kishore resembles an aeroplane while celebrating, and SRH's wings have been clipped again!
shortish just outside off. Klaasen gives himself room and cuts it through point for a couple of runs

Klaasen with another boundary, and this may be the warning siren for the Titans! Floated up into the slot on middle and off from over the wicket. Klaasen plants his front foot and wallops it over the bowler's head!
back of a length just outside off. Reddy dabs it towards backward point and gets Klaasen on strike

misfield, and that is all Reddy needs! Three boundaries in seven balls for SRH! Dragged down on middle and off from over the wicket. Reddy gives himself room and cracks it towards extra cover, who seems to dive over it!
back of a length on middle and off. Klaasen backs away but cannot generate the requisite room to cut it past extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Klaasen goes back and taps it towards extra cover
Klaasen is going after Rashid Khan! Loopy again and also in the slot on leg stump. Klaasen gets his front foot out of the way and smacks it over long on. First six of the evening for SRH!
fullish on middle and leg. Reddy skips down the track and turns it towards deep mid wicket
tossed up again, just outside off. Klaasen absolutely belts this but cannot beat Siraj at long off. Only a single
bam! Klaasen lands his first punch! Floated up full just outside off and Klaasen decides it is time. Gives himself room and pumps it over the bowler's head!
oh! Back of a length on middle and off. Bowled from over the wicket and this stops in the surface, with Reddy nearly popping it to extra cover
shortish on middle and leg. Klaasen stays back and punches it towards deep mid wicket
fired in on a back of a length just outside off. Reddy goes back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Reddy backs away early, trying to go inside-out but then changes his stroke to dab it behind point. Beaten in the flight and by the lack of pace
slowed up on a length on middle and off. Klaasen has a swipe at it and squirts it off the toe-end, just past the keeper. That came off very slow
back of a length on leg stump. Reddy glances it into the square leg region
fullish on the stumps. Reddy lunges forward and works it towards long on
full on middle and off. Reddy plays it back to the bowler, who fields it sharply on his follow-through
very full on off. Reddy digs it out towards extra cover

boundaries like London buses! SRH had to wait an eternity for one and now they have two! Slight drag-down outside off and Reddy cashes in. Rocks deep into his crease and hammers it between long on and deep mid wicket!
full just outside off. Reddy gets onto the front foot and pokes it towards extra cover
shot! Loopy low full toss just outside off. Reddy pre-meditates the reverse and also nails it past Gill at slip. Much-needed boundary!
back of a length just outside off. Keeps a little low but Reddy adjusts, pushing it off the back foot towards long on
shortish outside off. Klaasen sits deep in his crease and heaves it towards deep square leg. That stuck in the surface a fair bit
back of a length outside off. Reddy hangs back and punches it towards long on
back of a length on the stumps. Klaasen goes back and knocks it to long off
back of a length on leg stump. Reddy uses the angle and works it towards deep square leg
tossed up full on off. Klaasen eases it down the ground to long off
floated up full and wide. Reddy looks to go inside-out but only grabs a handful of fresh air
shortish outside off. Klaasen gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards sweeper cover
fired in on a length on middle and off. Klaasen, caught on the crease, prods at it and edges it towards backward point
angled in on a length on off. Reddy gets forward and knocks it to long on

fizzed in on a length just outside off. Klaasen presses forward and pushes it towards long off, where Siraj misfields and a double turns into three, just like that. Siraj went for a one-handed pick-up and then did not chase after the ball for a bit, which gave SRH more than enough time
back of a length on middle and leg. Reddy eases it out towards deep square leg. Wanted two initially but Washington was sharp off his mark
short ball outside off to end the over. Klaasen gauges it early enough and opts to let it go
hard length outside off. Klaasen waits on it and punches it towards backward point
dug into the track outside off. Reddy hops up onto his toes and opens his bat face to run it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Klaasen rises with the bounce and jabs it enough to extra cover's left to get off the mark

miscued and taken! Kishan bites the dust too, and Prasidh's wicket-taking exploits this IPL continue! Shortish on leg stump and this skids off the surface. Rushes onto Kishan and gets big on him too. Kishan wants to help this over fine leg but the extra pace means that he can only pick Ishant out to perfection at fine leg. Kishan walks back for a 14-ball 17, and this SRH innings is going nowhere!
dug into the track just outside off. Reddy gets up on his toes and hacks it enough to mid wicket's right for a single
googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Reddy tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket
more hesitation! Back of a length outside off. Reddy plays with the turn and dabs it towards short third. Kishan hares down for the single, only to be sent back
shortish just outside off. Kishan goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
leg-spinner on a length just outside off. Reddy pats it into the off side with soft hands and this single is much more comfortable
googly on a length on leg stump. Kishan hangs back and helps it towards deep square leg
full outside off. Kishan comes forward and pokes it towards extra cover

back of a length outside off. Kishan dabs it towards short third and then ball-watches, until Reddy is almost right next to him. Sets off for the single thereafter, but the throw from Siraj is to the batter's end. Reddy would have been short with a direct hit too. So, that was not a greatly-judged run

back of a length down leg. Kishan looks to help it away but fails to lay bat on ball. Called a wide, despite polite enquiries from the bowler and the keeper regarding a caught-behind. Okay, hang on. The Titans have actually reviewed this. Aiming to get the wide overturned. The ball has missed both the bat and the thigh pad, and GT burn a review, much to the joy of thousands of home fans!
slanted in full on middle and leg. Reddy punches it to mid on and hurtles across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. Kishan drops it into the off side and looks at his partner, who responds and tears across to complete the run
back of a length on middle and leg. Reddy eases it towards mid on and saunters across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. Reddy gets up on his toes and taps it towards extra cover
full and sliding down leg. Reddy has a swing at it and misses. Called a wide
length just outside off. Kishan tips it to mid off and dashes across to the other end. Nice, early call
length just outside off. Reddy drives it on the up towards extra cover. Gill misfields but no extra damage done
back of a length outside off. Reddy presses half forward and punches it towards cover

another soft, soft dismissal, and Siraj has two in the powerplay, and Travishek is back in the shed! Full on the stumps and Abhishek thinks he can tonk this over mid on. Does not get under it, though, and clinks it right off the toe-end. Tewatia settles himself at mid on and does the rest, and that is wicket number 100 for Siraj in the IPL. And what a wicket it is. Both SRH openers back in the shed, and GT will feel they are on top now!
back of a length on leg stump. No room whatsoever to work with and Abhishek plays it back to the bowler
banged into the track on middle and leg and this comes off much slower than Abhishek expects. He swipes at it too early and connects with fresh air
back of a length on leg stump. Kishan gets a half stride in and flicks it towards mid on

Abhishek is now coming after the Titans! In the slot just outside off. Abhishek transfers his weight forward and then muscles it towards mid on. Sai Kishore goes for the catch but is then beaten by the bounce as it lands on the half-volley
length outside off. Kishan gets onto the front foot and drives with an open bat face towards deep point
deft touch! On a length and offering a teensy bit of width. That much is enough for Kishan, who waits on it and then opens the bat face late to glide it to short third's left!
full, wide and returned with interest! This is a proper hit-me ball, and Kishan obliges. Gets his hands through the ball and crashes it over extra cover!
shortish on leg stump. Kishan looks for the pick-up pull but the ball arrives onto him much quicker than he expects. Jams into his thigh pad
angled in on a length on off. Kishan gets a decent stride in and pushes it towards extra cover
Abhishek ensures this over is not a maiden! Fullish ball in and around off. Abhishek plants his front foot and bangs it over mid off!
fuller on middle and leg. Abhishek looks to hack it over cow corner but shanks it towards mid wicket. On another day, that would have carried to the fielder
length ball angled across the batter on middle and off. Abhishek punches it on the up towards extra cover
hard length on middle and leg. Skips off the surface and rushes onto Abhishek, who ends up defending
back of a length on leg stump. Abhishek gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket
fullish just outside off. Abhishek gets onto the front foot confidently and pushes it towards extra cover
slanted in on a length on middle and off. Kishan presses half forward and chunks it off the inside half of the bat past mid wicket for a couple of runs
angled in full on middle and leg. Abhishek pokes it to mid on and hares across to the other end
full just outside off. Abhishek gets onto the front foot and laces his cover drive. Cannot get it past extra cover, though

goes up and over this time, and perhaps goes all the way too! More width on offer and even though this is a little more on a length, Abhishek throws his hands at it to scythe it over cover point. Lands just before the cushion!
scorched across the turf, and the crowd finds its voice! Long half-volley outside off and Abhishek will have that for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Frees his hands and cracks it past cover!
full outside off. Abhishek gets onto the front foot and drives it towards cover

chipped straight to mid wicket, and Siraj has silenced Hyderabad early! Fullish on the pads and this is there to be hit. Head, though, does not keep it down, nor does he go over that fielder. Pops it towards Sudharsan, who dives forward and completes a smart grab. Head cannot believe what he has done, and SRH are in early trouble again!
back of a length on leg stump. Head lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards mid wicket. That was bowled at 141.9kph
four more! Another stroke that Head is not greatly in control of but he will not mind it. Throws his hands at this full ball outside off and squirts it off the toe-end past short third!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Head watches it all the way and defends it towards mid on

edged and just past the stumps! And to add insult to injury, it trickles away to the fence! Back of a length just outside off. Head tries to carve it away through the off side and gets an inside edge that flashes past the stumps and beats Buttler to his right!
full on middle and off. A hint of in-swing and Abhishek presses forward to push it enough to mid off's right to get off the mark

Gill, fittingly, ices this run-chase, and he does so with with the easiest of clips into the leg side! The Titans win their third on the bounce, and SRH, beaten finalists and trendsetters last year, have now lost four on the trot! Back of a length on leg stump. Gill lets the ball come to him and with a nonchalant flick of the wrists, tucks it away towards deep square leg. Another clinical, clinical performance, and what would please GT the most is that this came after overcoming a slight wobble at the start!
zipped in full on middle and leg. Rutherford prods it back past the bowler, and the scores are level now!
Rutherford is toying with the bowling and the field placements now! Slower ball on a length outside off. Rutherford waits on this and glides it beautifully between short third and backward point!
pick the bones out of that one! Marginally short just outside off. Rutherford picks the length early, opens up his front hip and clatters it over deep mid wicket!
googly on a back of a length, spinning towards leg stump. Rutherford works it into the mid wicket region and keeps strike
full just outside off. Gill gets forward and opens his bat face to drive it towards sweeper cover
hang that in the Louvre! Looped up full and wide. Gill plants his front foot, gets his hands through the ball delightfully and creams it over extra cover!
swept away with disdain! Fuller and floatier on off stump. Gill gets down on one knee and scorches it through square leg!
back of a length on middle and off. Gill hangs back and prods it towards the bowler
fizzed in on a length just outside off. Rutherford comes forward and nurdles it into the mid wicket region
slower and fuller outside off. Rutherford lunges forward and pushes it towards deep extra cover

back of a length outside off. Rutherford goes reaching out for it and jams it off the inside edge into Klaasen's pads, with the ball then hitting the stumps, causing a brief fit of excitement among the crowd
short and wide outside off, and Rutherford gets this through too! All along the carpet this time past cover and cover point, and Rutherford is now helping himself to fours here, there and everywhere!
darted in full and beyond the tramlines on the off side. Left alone and called a wide
three fours in a row, and Rutherford is in a hurry! Slanted in full just outside off. Rutherford brings out the slog sweep and smears it to deep mid wicket's right!
Rutherford is feasting on what is being dished out here! More of a drag-down outside off. Rutherford lines it up and boshes it over extra cover!
Rutherford welcomes Abhishek with a boundary! Tossed up into the slot on middle and off. Rutherford gives himself room and carves it over extra cover!
almost! Cracking yorker on middle and off, and this nearly turns Rutherford inside-out. He gets a bit of bat on it and it dribbles away to deep third off the outside edge
into the blockhole just outside off. Rutherford jams down on it and squeezes it out towards backward point
back of a length, angling into middle and off. Rutherford gets behind the line and plays it back to the bowler
Rutherford is up and running, albeit in streaky fashion! Banged into the track on middle and off. Rutherford has a swipe at it and the ball flies off the top edge, well over the keeper's head!
slower short ball bowled a mile outside off. Rutherford lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length outside off. Rutherford gets up on his toes and jabs it towards backward point

has Aniket held on to that?! Would be a world-class grab if he has! Short, wide and Washington's eyes light up. He thinks he can carve this over point to get to his half-century but hits it too close to the sweeper. Aniket judges it nice and early and tears in off the fence. Lungs forward at the last moment and catches it. But the question is whether the ball was grounded at any point. This looks incredibly tight. Very touch-and-go. The third umpire has multiple looks at it, and reckons the fingers were underneath the ball. Wow, that is a big call, despite a slight suggestion that the ball may have grazed the grass at the very least. A moment of magic in the field nevertheless, and Washington is on his way!
full on middle and leg. Washington stretches forward and flicks it to long on
full on leg stump. Gill presses forward again and knocks it to long on
full on leg stump. Gill comes onto the front foot and pats it towards mid wicket

oh dear - that is not going to help SRH at all! Shortish outside off. Gill waits deep in his crease and cuts it powerfully towards deep point. Aniket gets around to it but the ball then slips through his fingers. Fifty up for Gill and this has been a classy knock!
very full on off. Washington comes forward and digs it out towards long off
back of a length outside off. Gill waits for the ball to spin before pushing it towards sweeper cover

short and Washington latches onto it! Not a great deal of pace to trouble Washington and he jumps up onto his toes, while also lifting up his front leg Calypso style. Pummels it behind square and picks up four!
length outside off. Washington gets a half stride in and taps it towards backward point
another slower short ball, sitting up on off stump. Gill waits for it and short-arm jabs it towards deep mid wicket
slower bumper outside off. Washington gets up on his toes, rolls his wrists and pulls it towards deep square leg
back of a length outside off. Gill gets up on his toes and punches it towards sweeper cover
back of a length on off. Washington takes a step down the track and jabs it towards sweeper cover
oof, Gill is putting on a batting clinic now! Length outside off. Gill presses forward, gets on top of the bounce nicely and caresses it between extra cover and mid off!
length outside off. Washington drives it firmly to mid off and sets off for the single. Knows immediately that he will need to scramble and is saved by Unadkat missing the stumps at the bowler's end
back of a length outside off. Washington gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Gill stays a little leg side of the ball and eases it to extra cover's left
hard length, honing into off stump. Gill gets behind the line and plays the perfect defensive stroke
shortish outside off. Gill gets up on his toes and dabs it past backward point for a couple of runs
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill helps it round the corner and is happy with six coming off the over
googly on a back of a length outside off. Washington hangs back and chops it towards backward point
fullish on leg stump. Washington nurdles it perfectly into the gap between deep mid wicket and deep square leg and bags a brace
tossed up full outside off. Gill stretches forward and drives it crisply towards long off
into the blockhole on middle and off. Gill digs it out towards extra cover
flighted up full just outside off. Washington gets down on one knee and slogs it on the bounce to long on
angled in quicker and fuller on leg stump. Washington works it towards deep mid wicket and keeps strike
that is a shot right out of the top drawer! Floated up into the slot just outside off. Washington gives himself room and creams it over extra cover!
slower on a length on leg stump. Gill tucks it off his pads into the mid wicket region
full on leg stump. Gill stretches forward and nudges it perfectly between deep mid wicket and long on. Saunters back for two
loose ball and put away! This is a bit of a drag-down, also drifting onto the pads. Gill rolls his wrists and shovels it behind square for four!
back of a length just outside off. Gill hangs back and cuts it towards backward point
full on middle and leg. Gill gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Washington goes back and taps it enough to extra cover's right for a single
googly on a full length just outside off. Washington goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
back of a length outside off. Gill reaches out for it and jabs it towards sweeper cover
smart, smart batting! Short and wide outside off. Rather than smashing the cover off the ball, Gill plays with an open bat face and threads it between backward point and short third!
dragged down outside off. Washington hops back and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length just outside off. Washington drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Gill plonks it towards mid off and skips across to the other end
back of a length on middle and leg. Washington works it with the angle towards deep mid wicket

shot! Washington is batting on a different surface altogether! Back of a length on middle and leg. Washington uses his wrists to superb effect and bisects deep square leg and fine leg with surgical precision!
back of a length just outside off. Gill eases it down the ground to long on
back of a length outside off. Gill waits for it and pats it towards the bowler
six more! Simarjeet is not learning, and Washington is not relenting! Another short ball on middle and leg. Washington swivels inside the line and hooks it with minimal fuss over fine leg!
dug into the track with more conviction and this gets big on Washington, on middle and off. He fends it uppishly towards the bowler

oh wow - that is a shot and a half! Back of a length on middle and off. Washington walks across his stumps early and then channels his inner Suryakumar Yadav. Just a flick of the wrists and the ball goes soaring over fine leg!
hard length on middle and off. Washington gets up on his toes and defends it towards mid wicket
four fours in a row for the Titans! Another shortish ball outside off. Sits up for Washington and he rocks back to plunder it over mid wicket!
Washington joins in on the fun! Marginally short just outside off. Washington picks the length early, stands tall and pounds it over mid on!
back to back boundaries for Shubman Gill! Back of a length on the hips and this is easy pickings for a batter of Gill's class. He uses the angle and clips it effortlessly past mid wicket!
shot - that is Gill at his very best! In the slot just outside off. Gill plants his front foot, snaps his wrists into action and whips it over mid on!
back of a length just outside off. Washington lets the ball come to him before tapping it towards deep backward point
back of a length on leg stump. Gill stabs it towards mid on and canters across to the other end
angled in on a length just outside off. Gill gets a half stride in and punches it towards mid on
back of a length outside off. Washington waits for it and jabs it towards deep backward point
length just outside off. Washington pokes it enough to mid off's right and gets off the mark with a sharp single

nicked and gone! What a corker from the SRH captain, and the crowd responds with an enormous roar! Back of a length in the channel and this decks back in sharply. Buttler goes feeling for it and gets the faintest of tickles while also getting cut in absolute half. SRH flags flapping in the distance, Cummins with a beaming smile on his face, and GT, well, in a spot of bother early!
slanted in on a length just outside off. Buttler presses half forward and pushes it back towards Cummins
hard length on middle and leg. Gill turns it into the mid wicket region and sets off for the single. Well-judged run in the end
back of a length on off. Holds a little in the surface and Gill plonks it back towards the bowler
back of a length outside off. Gill hangs back and jabs it towards cover
back of a length in the channel. Buttler goes nibbling at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket

Shami with the breakthrough, and Sudharsan throws his head back in disappointment! Banged into the track on middle and leg. Sudharsan shapes for the pull but cannot keep it down. Hits it rather tamely towards square leg, where Aniket, stationed right on the ring, gobbles up the chance to his left. Massive wicket, and the crowd is up and about now!
slanted in full on leg stump. Gill tips it to mid on and scampers across to the other end
stop that, Shubman Gill! Length outside off and Gill climbs into this. Steps forward, leans into the drive and then crrrrrrrrrrrrruunnnnnnnnnnnnchhhhhessssss it between extra cover and mid off!
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan has a stab at it and squirts it off the bottom edge towards the keeper
back of a length outside off. Gill waits for it and with an open bat face, dabs it towards deep backward point
length just outside off. Gill drops it into the off side and Sudharsan responds to his call. A bit of a scurry but no damage done. A direct hit might have been it for Gill, though
fullish just outside off. Sudharsan takes a step down the track and drives it towards Cummins, who gets his left hand to it and takes the sting out of the stroke. Cannot stop the single, though
hard length on middle and off. Skids onto Sudharsan and he hurriedly pokes it off the back foot towards cover

length in the channel. Gill looks to drive on the up and shanks it towards mid on. Calls for the single and has to scramble to get there. Sharp work by Simarjeet to also hit the stumps in the same motion
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid on for a quick single
length in the channel. Sudharsan presses half forward and taps it towards cover
in-swinging yorker on leg stump. Sudharsan tracks it well and tucks it off his toes towards deep square leg
short and wide outside off. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and laces his square cut. Cannot beat cover point in the ring, though. Good work by Kamindu
back of a length delivery that is fired down leg. Klaasen does well to get something on it and Shami offers a hand of apology soon after
full on the pads. Gill gets onto the front foot and helps it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length just outside off. Curves away again and Gill meets it right under his eyes with soft hands
back of a length in the channel and this swings away late. Gill accounts for it and defends it into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg. Shapes back a touch and Sudharsan flicks it towards mid wicket, who can only get a hand to it. Off the mark with a single
